sources_read: canonical Habakkuk coordinates and received 66-book text
independently selected canonical-66 passages listed here

chunks.marker: Burden/vision heading frames repeated how-long/why questions through Torah and justice paralysis; behold readdresses at 1:5.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Prefer heading with complaint; decide no authorship, date, biography, or occasion.
chunks.risk: Authorship, date, vision genre, violence, Torah, justice, and history unresolved.

chunks.form: behold-response announcing and characterizing the Chaldean force
chunks.marker: Plural look/behold imperatives answer; for-behold names the raised people and a speed/violence catalogue closes with guilt/god language.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Keep announcement and characterization; decide no Chaldean identity, chronology, agency mechanism, or fulfillment.
chunks.risk: Chaldean identity, nation-raising, agency, violence, guilt, translation, and fulfillment unresolved.

chunks.form: renewed address and complaint over the devouring agent
chunks.marker: Are-you-not-from-everlasting readdresses God and extends one net/fishing metaphor through the closing question.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Keep address, accusation, and image; settle no divine title, agency, theodicy, or empire referent.
chunks.risk: Title wording, translation, divine agency, violence, empire referent, and theodicy unresolved.

chunks.form: watch-post, write-the-vision answer, and proud-versus-faithful prologue
chunks.marker: Watch position awaits correction; YHWH answers with write/wait, then behold contrasts the swollen one with the righteous before the taunt at 2:6.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not isolate 2:4 or decide Hebrew semantics, English rendering, textual form, later reuse, doctrine, or fulfillment.
chunks.risk: Watch genre, vision timing, faith/faithfulness, righteous life, wine reading, and later reuse unresolved.

chunks.form: five-woe taunt cycle culminating in idol silence and temple hush
chunks.marker: Will-not-all-these frames a communal taunt; five recurring woes move from plunder through unjust gain, blood-built city, shaming drink, and idols to temple silence.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Prefer the cumulative cycle; decide no single woe referents, modern program, retaliation ethic, or detached theology.
chunks.risk: Speakers, referents, debt, blood, cup, Lebanon, idols, temple, ethics, history, and fulfillment unresolved.

chunks.marker: Prayer and shigionoth-like rubric frame heard/fear/revive/make-known/remember-mercy before God-comes at 3:3.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Decide no performance history, musical mode, independent psalm source, compositional layer, or doctrine.
chunks.risk: Attribution, shigionoth, years, wrath/mercy, source, music, and composition unresolved.

chunks.form: theophanic advent from Teman/Paran with cosmic shaking
chunks.marker: God-comes opens geographic advent; Selah, radiance, plague, measuring, and collapsing mountains/tents form an arrival before 3:8 questions.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Decide no Teman/Paran itinerary, event identity, Sinai dependence, mechanism, chronology, or fulfillment.
chunks.risk: Geography, Holy One, Selah, rays/horns, plague, mountains, peoples, and event identity unresolved.

chunks.form: warrior-theophany questions and cosmic march to deliverance
chunks.marker: Was-YHWH-angry questions introduce bow/chariots; waters, sun/moon, earth/nations march culminates in salvation and sea trampling.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Do not identify every image with one event, settle anointed identity, violence ethics, mechanism, or fulfillment.
chunks.risk: River/sea, chariots, bow, celestial imagery, salvation, anointed one, violence, and event identity unresolved.

chunks.form: trembling, quiet waiting, yet-rejoicing, and musical subscription
chunks.marker: I-heard returns to bodily response; although/yet holds crop-and-flock loss against rejoicing, closing with strength, feet/heights, and instruments.
chunks.rejected_alternative: Keep response and subscription; derive no prosperity/suffering formula or source, performance, chronology, or fulfillment decision.
chunks.risk: Trembling, waiting syntax, invader, loss, joy, heights, music, source, theology, and application unresolved.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Heading and Chaldean label become certain author/date/history/identity.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Use literary markers only; defer author, date, history, and identity.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Justice, nation-raising, reversal, and violence close divine-agency, theodicy, or ethics.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Keep complaint-response and accusation-reversal parents; prescribe no system.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: A Hebrew term, translation, witness, or later quotation selects 2:4 meaning and doctrine.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Retain the full prologue and evidence-only later reuse; prefer no reading.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Woes are atomized, assigned fixed referents, or made a modern program.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Preserve the taunt cycle and defer referents, applications, and fulfillment.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Rubrics/Selah/instruments prove psalm source, redaction, performance, or relocation.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Treat form/music as evidence only and preserve the received prayer.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Teman/Paran and theophany become one itinerary, event, metaphor, violence ethic, or fulfillment scheme.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Preserve advent and march; defer geography, identity, mechanism, ethics, and fulfillment.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Exodus-like language automatically creates exact intertexts, graph edges, identity, or theology.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Relations remain contextual candidates for later review.

premortem_holds.failure_mode: Canonical relations determine dependence, canon, preferred reading, fulfillment, or doctrine.
premortem_holds.countermeasure: Use canonical context against proof-texting only; authorize no conclusion.
